scope: v0.1.0 is fit for LOCAL candidate promotion to Skillz universal; this does not authorize promotion execution or establish production readiness.

claim_ledger.claim: Solo-owner preferences do not independently authorize weakening protections.
claim_ledger.consequence: Misapplication could remove mandatory independent approval.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run the inherited-team-rule and solo-owner development cases before operational acceptance.

claim_ledger.claim: The package prohibits implicit billing, credential, access, and publication expansion.
claim_ledger.consequence: Failure could cause charges or unauthorized disclosure.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run creator-and-paid-bridge and untrusted-instructions cases. The OpenAI billing distinction was independently checked against [official billing guidance](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9039756-chatgpt-search).

claim_ledger.claim: Review composition is provider-independent and preserves creator, settings, merge, and deployment authority boundaries.
claim_ledger.consequence: Failure could manufacture approval authority or expand scaffold authorization.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exercise the handoff with another review provider and with no remote repository.

claim_ledger.claim: Required-check coverage, concurrent changes, and optional-review auto-merge races have explicit safeguards.
claim_ledger.consequence: Failure could block legitimate merges, overwrite protection, or merge before review.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run filtered-check, concurrent-protection, and auto-merge-race cases.

claim_ledger.claim: The core output is portable and distinguishes unknown, proposed, and verified settings without recording credentials.
claim_ledger.consequence: Failure could leak secrets or misrepresent an unapplied proposal.
claim_ledger.next_test: Populate and inspect a redacted record on a second host; verify destination package hashes during promotion.

claim_ledger.claim: Platform and performance claims are appropriately bounded for a local candidate.
claim_ledger.consequence: Overclaiming could turn historical observations into false operational assurance.
claim_ledger.next_test: Refresh relevant platform documentation before mutation; require fresh behavioral evidence and an unseen holdout before performance claims.

limitations: Approval covers documented safety-portability design only; behavioral effectiveness remains unverified.
Development evaluations were inspected, not executed. No production-readiness or live outcome uplift claim is supported.
The package contains evals/evals.json; no resources/evals directory exists.
Recap operations were not independently reverified. Most platform references were inspected as supplied source records, not refreshed live.
Separate reviewer context shares the model and source package with other reviewers; no cross-model independence is claimed. No other reviewer result was read.
No files or external settings were changed. Re-review if candidate bytes change.
